title: Private Recording Studio Experience in Downtown Nashville
includes: State of the art recording equipment
21,000 Backing tracks to nearly every hit song ever made
A 90 minute recording session with a experienced engineer.
A behind the scenes musical experience
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Nashvox is Nashville’s only fully functional, professional recording studio for the public. Providing The Nashville Studio Experience to all. With over 20,0000 available backing tracks, Nashvox gives you the opportunity to record your favorite songs. 

All recording booths, include windows to allow family and friends to view your sessions. Additionally, the studio houses 9 individual studios of various sizes, authentic Music City memorabilia, and selfie stations.

This is the studio for everyone, specializing in groups and children’s sessions. Nashvox is also handicap accessible.

Take home the music you record in Nashville & listen to it forever!
